data.name: Enkrid

fields.class path: Bloodcharged > Overcharged > Charge Engineer > Archwright > Grand Archwright
fields.profession path: Tinker > Engineer > Sapper > Yardmaster > Skyforge Engineer

text: Orphaned road fae; no one would stand up for him. Wiry, small for his age, and sure it's a curse. He sees the sky ship as escape and adventure, and tinkering as his way onto a ship. He carries the inventor's pocket watch and wants to find the three legends, sure they still live.

Motivation: To escape the mundane and cruel life of the mainland, to travel, building power and knowledge to feel in control of his life.
Path note: Walks the Inventor's path (decided 3 Nov): main story to C-grade Archwright and Yardmaster, B-grade in the post-game.

data.name: Rook

fields.class path: Theorist > Furnace Adept > Stormcaller > Tempest Sage > Stormlord
fields.profession path: Cartographer > Navigator > Chartwright > Master Charter > Archipelago Wright

text: Crow-kin from an old Bench family on the mainland, raised to copy charts and never draw one. Has seen every coastline in his father's archive once, so he can draw them all, and can do his father's voice well enough to sign for him. He left with one satchel, three stolen pens, and a debt of disappointment he means to outrun.

Motivation: To escape the mundane and cruel life of the mainland, building power and knowledge to feel free from family and cultural expectations.

data.name: Tova

fields.role: Party member. Protagonist 3, and technically the party leader.
fields.class path: Vanguard > Ironside > Captain > Commodore > Fleet Admiral

text: Monsterkin, big, loud and the first on deck because no inn will have her. Has worked every dock in the Reach and been paid less than the human beside her on all of them. Keeps a scrapbook of wanted posters and plans to be on one, for the right reasons.

Motivation: She wants to prove she and those called monsterkin are more than they seem, and fame never hurt her!

data.name: Captain Isolde Varr

fields.role: Legend. Legendary B-grade, one of the three who pass through Enkrid's village. Vanished.
fields.class path: Vanguard > Ironside > Captain > Commodore > Fleet Admiral

text: Stops the local boys and tells Enkrid life is worth living, if only to see the world's mysteries. Shares a start with Tova.

data.name: Elian Marsh

fields.role: Legend. Legendary B-grade, the cartographer. Vanished.
fields.class path: Theorist > Furnace Adept > Stormcaller > Tempest Sage > Stormlord
fields.profession path: Cartographer > Navigator > Chartwright > Master Charter > Archipelago Wright

text: Brings up Enkrid's age: he must learn and grow before facing the Sea of Possibility. Shares a start with Rook.

data.name: Aurelio Fenn

fields.role: Legend. Legendary B-grade, the tinker. Inventor of the brume possibility engine. Vanished.
fields.class path: Bloodcharged > Overcharged > Charge Engineer > Archwright > Grand Archwright
fields.profession path: Tinker > Engineer > Sapper > Yardmaster > Skyforge Engineer

text: Leaves Enkrid a crystal-faced, engraved pocket watch. Shares a start with Enkrid.

data.name: Brother Ansel

fields.role: The Wright chaplain who schools Enkrid for four years on the legends' coin.

text: Patient, underpaid, and secretly proud. Taught Enkrid letters, sums, and to take apart the chapel clock only if he could put it back.

fields.role: The village boy who leads the beating in the prologue.

data.name: Odile Sallow
text: Fox-kin, sharp-dressed, and always with a second story ready. Calls every question a new crew asks "stupid, basic, and naive", and answers them anyway, for a price. Knows more about the missing merchant's daughter than she says.

data.name: Hollis Tarrant

fields.role: The wealthy merchant whose daughter is missing.

text: A charge-lamp importer on Refinery Row, rich enough to pay and proud enough not to ask the Compact for help.

data.name: Petra Tarrant
text: Went into the Undercourses after something she saw from her window. Alive, for now.

data.name: Binder Maren Quell

fields.role: The licensed binder at the Compact's Binding House.

text: Has bound a thousand people and stopped promising any of them it won't hurt.

fields.role: Keeps the Lantern and Lee, the one inn on the quay that takes monsterkin.

data.name: Captain Silvan Rourke

fields.role: Captain of the first ship, the Gilded Tern. Leaves the heroes behind for nobles. Later revealed as the antagonist.

text: Polished, generous in public, and paid twice for every berth.

fields.role: The noble whose party takes the heroes' berths on the Gilded Tern.
The giant rat of the Undercourses. Chapter 1's first real fight.

data.name: the Gloam

fields.role: The thing in the dark under Ashford. Much stronger than the rats; keeps out of the sunlight. Chapter 1's boss.

text: Brume pooled under Ashford for forty years of refinery run-off and woke up as something hungry. It can't bear a fixed light: sunlight settles it.
